items.headline: $CYS Bridge Halted After Attacker Mints 10M Tokens
items.summary: Cysic suspended its bridge after an attacker minted 10 million $CYS and funneled about $727,000 to Ethereum via Mayan, deBridge and SWFT Bridgers.

items.headline: $WLD Launches World ID for Banks, Zoom Deepfake Checks
items.summary: World rolled out a World ID suite for banks and made its Zoom deepfake detection tool generally available, expanding $WLD's identity ecosystem.

items.headline: $HEX Founder Richard Heart Arrested in Turkey
items.summary: Turkey confirmed Richard Heart's arrest, seizing $7.15 million in cash and six cold wallets. $HEX already sank 31% on earlier detention reports.

items.headline: $CC: DTCC Picks Canton for 25-Security Tokenization
items.summary: DTCC outlined a 25-security tokenization rollout on Canton and Besu, with tokens backed 1:1 by DTC-held securities — a big institutional win for $CC.

items.headline: Kalshi, Polymarket Hold Off as Missouri Sued Over Sports Contracts
items.summary: Crypto.com and Novig sued Missouri over sports event contract cease-and-desists, while Kalshi, Polymarket and Robinhood have not filed suits.
